bug_families.title: Confirmed refund can be followed by a suspended consumable grant
bug_families.root_cause: Confirmed pre-grant reversal left no atomic profile marker; an old verified grant could pass after the claim had become voided.
bug_families.fix: Persist a zero-valued ungranted reversal marker in the owner profile transaction; the existing grant path rejects that token.

bug_families.title: Stale subscription fulfillment or reconciliation can override newer lifecycle and lose a published grant
bug_families.root_cause: Cross-record profile/claim lifecycle writes lacked a shared version fence and completion could race the claims projection.
bug_families.fix: Subscription claim CAS, persistent per-token profile fence, registration-after-ownership plus fresh provider revalidation, authoritative final completion CAS after projection, and fenced failure metadata.

intentional_existing_expectation_changes: retained-record full profile equality includes exact zero-value revocation metadata; all other profile fields remain equal
first subscription provider validation2 + replay1 =3; unrelated monetary/idempotency assertions retained
held claims query count3 = initial held read + final purchase projection + required retry after revision changes
client_retry_check: luno_online_billing_backend delegates retryability to LunoOnlineService.isRetryableFailure; status503 remains retryable and unknown code is sanitized to verification-unavailable
